core_meaning.primary_meaning: Salah is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Righteousness, goodness”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Salah corresponds to the Arabic form صَلَاح (Arabic root ص ل ح (ṣ-l-ḥ); صَلَاح (Ṣalāḥ)). Its core sense is salah; righteousness, goodness. Salah is Arabic صَلَاح (Ṣalāḥ), meaning 'righteousness, goodness'. It is distinct from صَلَاة (ṣalāh, ritual prayer).
